item.title: [ZEPPELIN-776] CI: PySpark tests failure on PR208
item.description:
zeppelin-server tests in ZeppelinSparkClusterTest consistently failing on pySpark part

-----------------

TODOs:

  • General
  • force CI to use [container-based infrastructure](https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/workers/container-based-infrastructure/#Routing-your-build-to-container-based-infrastructure) - #808

  • to install R+dependencies follow https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/migrating-from-legacy/#How-do-I-install-APT-sources-and-packages%3F

It looks very much related to recent https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK-12101

The only question is - why is it reproducible on PR 208 and not on master?

Apparently I have found the difference: CI infrastructure on apache/incubator-zeppelin for master and PR208 is different!

PR208 is somehow always run on GCE infrastructure https://blog.travis-ci.com/2015-11-27-moving-to-a-more-elastic-future VS master is run on a containerized one https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/workers/container-based-infrastructure

The reason could be

For repos we recognize before 2015-01-01, linux builds are sent to our standard infrastructure.
For repos we recognize on or after 2015-01-01, linux builds are sent to our container-based infrastructure.

So my educated guess is that: networking setup is dramatically different in those environment, which results in triggering SPARK-12101 every time only on of them and failing the Zeppelin tests.

So, the fix should consist of 2 parts

General: hadled under https://github.com/apache/incubator-zeppelin/pull/808

  • force CI to container-based infrastructure https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/workers/container-based-infrastructure/#Routing-your-build-to-container-based-infrastructure

PR 208

  • remove SUDO everywhere from .travis.yaml
  • to install R+dependencies. follow https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/migrating-from-legacy/#How-do-I-install-APT-sources-and-packages%3F
